decision.observation: 10 mph, gear 1, two blue dots lit. The car is off the tarmac on grass, facing the long left wall of a red barn with an EXHAUST banner and a bale stack beyond it. The actual lane runs diagonally up-right along the frame edge, and tarmac shows at the bottom of the frame behind the car.
decision.hypothesis: The W hold carried the car past the left side of the barn onto the yard instead of around the bend. Driving forward would hit the barn wall, so backing up should pull it toward the lane visible behind/below.
decision.memory: The lane at the red barn passes down the right side of the barn, not the left. Blundering into this yard is a known failure; reverse to regain the lane.
